data.deleteSub: Removes every profile, chat, journal entry and setting from this phone
data.title: Delete all data?
data.message:
Every profile, chat, journal entry, saved answer and setting on this phone will be deleted. This can't be undone. Export a backup first if you might want them back.

The downloaded model stays so you don't have to download it again. Uninstalling the app removes everything.

licences.title: Licences
licences.intro: Astropedia is built with open-source software and openly licensed AI models. Thank you to everyone who makes them.

sections.p: Everything you enter: names, birth dates, times and places, chats, journal entries, saved answers and settings. Astropedia has no servers that receive this data, no account and no sign-in.

Downloading the on-device AI model and checking for model updates, both from Hugging Face. Hugging Face sees the request, as any website sees your IP address; nothing about you or your charts is sent. If a birth place has no built-in map coordinates, only the place name is looked up on OpenStreetMap. Links you open go to those websites.
The app contains no analytics, crash reporting, advertising or tracking code. If the app hits an error, the details stay on the phone unless you choose to share them.
Reminders are scheduled on the phone itself. No push server is involved.

An exported backup file contains birth details, chats and your journal. It is saved where you choose; treat it like any private document. Your phone's own backup (iCloud or Google) may also include app data, under your control.
Settings → About → Delete all my data removes everything from this phone. Uninstalling the app also removes it.
Astropedia is not directed at children under 13.
Astropedia offers traditional Vedic astrology for reflection and curiosity. It does not predict the future as fact and is not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice.
Answers are generated by an AI model on your phone and can be wrong or incomplete. Use your own judgement and consult a qualified professional for important decisions.
Your data is yours and stays on your phone. You are responsible for any backup files you export or share.
The AI models are provided under their own licences (Gemma Terms of Use, Llama 3.2 Community License, Apache 2.0). By downloading a model you agree to its licence and its acceptable-use policy.
The app is provided as is, without warranties. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for decisions made using it.
